translations.web: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’ ” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against Me,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: As keepers of a field are they against her round about, because she hath been rebellious against me, saith Jehovah.
